noVideoTitle: Choose a video to start repeating
noVideoDesc: Supports local videos (mp4 / webm / mov) and audio (mp3 / wav etc.). You can also drag files (together with subtitles) from Windows Explorer into the window. The waveform is analyzed automatically, a same-named subtitle loads automatically, and you can use AB repeat and loop selected subtitle segments.

drop.hint: Drop to import: the same-named subtitle loads automatically

ab.tipIdle: Click while playing to set point A; click while stopped then pick on the waveform
ab.tipB: Click again to set point B and start looping
ab.hintPickA: AB repeat: click on the waveform to set point A
ab.hintPickB: AB repeat: click on the waveform to set point B (or click this button to use the current position)
ab.gapInvalid: Point B must be after point A (at least 0.3s)

list.title: Subtitles
list.selectionEmpty: Check or drag-select subtitle segments to repeat first
list.dragHint: Click to seek · double-click to edit · checking any cue auto-plays the selection; uncheck to stop
list.emptyDesc: Click "Load Subtitles" or drop a subtitle file into the window; a same-named subtitle (srt/vtt/ass etc.) next to the video loads automatically

toast.videoError: Failed to load video, please choose another file

toast.needVideoFirst: Load a video before importing a subtitle file
toast.shadowStart: Shadow mode: playing original, recording starts at sentence end
toast.shadowRecording: ● Recording… press the shadow key again to stop

toast.compareNeedRec: No recording yet — press "Shadow recording" first
toast.shadowNeedCue: Locate playback at a cue first
toast.setAFirst: Set the loop start point (A) first

audioMode: Audio repeat mode · waveform, AB repeat and subtitles work like video

fav.noVideo: This saved cue has no linked video to locate

fav.filterEmpty: No saved cues in this group

remote.title: Gamepad / Remote Key Mapping
remote.pairHint: Pair your Bluetooth repeat controller (e.g. Yimanxin BHA01) in Windows Bluetooth settings first. After pairing, its buttons arrive as media/keyboard keys to the focused SmartSub window. Click "Bind" then press a button to map it; Esc cancels. Media keys (Play/Pause, Prev/Next track) have default bindings.
remote.bleHint: Direct link for proprietary BLE repeat controllers (e.g. Yimanxin BHA02): buttons work instantly once connected, window focus not required. Double-press power to wake a sleeping controller and it reconnects automatically. Click "Pad key" then press a button to bind.
remote.playLastTitle: Open and play the most recently played media
remote.aABack: A-: set A; if set, move back 0.5s
remote.aAFwd: A+: set A; if set, move forward 0.5s
remote.aBBack: B-: set B; if set, move back 0.5s
remote.aBFwd: B+: set B; if set, move forward 0.5s (hold 1s to clear AB)
